name: Dashboard Resilience & Security Verification Rig
description: Deterministic ground-truth contract asserting web monitor resilience, path traversal immunity, and frontend bundle integrity

steps.name: Verify Domain AST Purity (Zero I/O in Domain)
steps.command: python3 -c "import os, ast; violations = [f for root, _, files in os.walk('src/bento/domain') for f in files if f.endswith('.py') and any(isinstance(node, ast.Import) and any(n.name in ('os', 'sys', 'subprocess', 'requests', 'urllib') for n in node.names) for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(open(os.path.join(root, f)).read())))]; exit(len(violations))"

assertions.description: Zero unauthorized I/O imports in domain layer
